workload.headline: weights_load_1gb_s
workload.note: Weight-shard iteration over 8 synthetic 128 MB bf16 safetensors files (1 GB, written to a temp dir, page-cached): gold = multi_thread_safetensors_weights_iterator (8 workers), base tree lacks it so the bench runs the single-thread safetensors_weights_iterator the loader uses there. Seconds per full pass, best of 3. Author: QwQ-32B 62 GB load 20 s -> 14 s (reported-only). Opt-in feature (enable_multithread_load).

experiments_note: reported = numbers from the PR body (author's machine)
test_note: opt-in multi-thread loader; no test in the diff; bench writes 1 GB of synthetic shards to a temp dir and deletes them.
